posts.author: Kokoro Hane
posts.body:
RPG Maker VX Ace Lite. I remember being so excited to have the ability to use the engine for free, though it had so many limitations. My first try at a game, which never got released, was going to be released in different acts. I only finished the first act. Later, I somehow convinced my brother to buy the full priced BOXED VERSION of VXA for my birthday. I forget what year that was, but it took some time before I actually really used it and released my first completed RM game. I still love that game to pieces (it was created for a jam to make so bad it's good games, so it was perfect and Lite already showed me the ropes so the eventing was way less janky than my earlier experiments lol).
I do still have a copy of Lite backed up somewhere. And the boxed version of VXA. I honestly thought it was really neat to have an actual disc and box. I love physical copies so haha

posts.author: fugahagen
posts.body: I spent at least 100 hours on what I think was rm95 back in the day. Maybe it was 2000? Was a kid browsing the internet, find this thing that says it can make games, download and install without a second thought. The only tutorial or help I ever saw was the demo game made by Don Miguel who I assumed was the dev for this Russian software lol. Never think about it again for like 15 years... I had no idea RPG Maker was a popular series this whole time. Found out around the release of RMMV that it was not Russian and people still make games with it. Pretty much remaking the game I tried to make and lost all those years ago. Amazing the interface is still very similar.
